maintenance_led.reason: Largest segment is integrated therapy services (pump rental to oncology and pain clinics); biomedical repair and device sales are the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes mainly from commercial insurers and payers, plus providers like oncology practices and hospitals; Medicare is a smaller share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own therapy services, rentals and biomedical services; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Infusion pumps and clinic-to-home therapy support with 24/7 nursing are embedded in patient care; switching means retraining and disruption.

notes: Payer mix and segment split are based on my recollection, not the website text.
